Assessment details

Static configuration analysis cannot validate live reachability, effective identity-provider MFA, peer behavior, certificate trust chains, or operational state. Unselected domains are not assessed.

Risk is CRITICAL with any critical finding or score ≥ 50; HIGH ≥ 25; MEDIUM ≥ 10; otherwise LOW. LOW is a score classification, not a security guarantee.

Reports include sensitive network context. Protect them as confidential audit artifacts. Configured credential values are redacted from HTML; legacy TXT/JSON keep their existing confidentiality behavior.
